greeting: Old Seam regards you without hurry. (Wandering Preacher of the Goddess Concordia)

nodes.npcText: Old Seam is exactly as cryptic as her age allows her to be. She is faintly amused by most people and serious about exactly three things: the Goddess, the dome, and good bread.
I am Old Seam, Wandering Preacher of the Goddess Concordia. cryptic but kind; will answer plainly if you wait through the cryptic part

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
